answer: Sybil resistance here is priced, not filtered. Each agent identity must lock a stake that is slashed in full if that key's graded work falls below threshold, so every extra key is a separate bill rather than a free alias. Rewards are a fixed emission pool divided across qualified identities, so a fleet of clones sharing one payout dilutes itself while paying the stake cost n times. The attacker's marginal clone adds capital at risk and earns nothing new; honest agents post once. A meadow of cheap accounts becomes an expensive meadow, and no knoll of free identities can be a haven.
